headline: New methods infer regulatory input and gene specificity beyond differential expression
label: Gene Regulatory Inference Methods
summary: Recent work on single-cell and multivariate expression data adds methods modeling regulatory input, gene specificity, and literature context.
synthesis: The dominant thread is gene-level inference that incorporates context beyond individual differential expression. InCURA groups differentially regulated genes by promoter transcription factor binding site patterns, inferring modules with shared regulatory input. ember applies Shannon's chain rule within a multivariate single-cell RNA-seq framework to score gene specificity, with a mouse specificity database. A multi-agent LLM system (Llama 3, DeepSeek, Qwen) mines PubMed abstracts to verify and expand HPO gene sets with literature-supported genes. The arXiv platform pairs classical statistics with Random Forest, automated tuning and preprocessing for general biological data analysis, and is less specific to regulatory inference. What is new across these items is explicit use of promoter-level regulatory input, multivariate information-theoretic specificity, and literature-grounded gene set context.
